instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: Shareholders must also follow certain steps to approve it. For some mergers and other matters, SpaceX's articles of incorporation set rules. Holders of Class B shares must vote as a separate group and approve it. Other required approvals are needed too. Musk's support is not a path that opens every gate. We do not know if talks will really be delayed this time, so watch not only does Musk support it, but also how will others react? Will cheers help things move forward or will closer checks make people drive carefully? A big name's words can fire the starting gun or give people a reason to stop. Since someone has spoken in favor, we must watch others' next moves in these talks.
